tha-ap177:1.4: sīhāsanamadāsahaṁ bahūhi gandhamālehi → sīhāsanam adās ahaṁ pahūtagandhamalyehi (pts)
tha-ap177:2.1: bahūhi gandhamālehi diṭṭhadhammasukhāvahe → pahutagandhamālehi diṭṭhadhamme sukhāvahe (bj) | pahutagandhamālehi → bahuhi gandhamālehi (bj: machasaṁ) | Pahūtagandhamalyehi → G. bahutagandhamālehi. (pts note)
tha-ap177:2.2: diṭṭhadhammasukhāvahe → paralokasukhāvaho (sya-all) | diṭṭhadhammasukhāvahe → S2 diṭṭhaṁ dhammasukhāvaho. (pts note)
tha-ap177:2.3: pūjañca katvāna → pūjaṁ karitvāna (bj, sya-all, pts) | karitvāna → pūjañca katvāna (bj: machasaṁ) | karitvāna → G. S1 ca katvāna. (pts note)
tha-ap177:3.4: nupapajjahaṁ pannarasasahassamhi → nūpapajjahaṁ paṇṇarasasahassamhi (bj, sya-all) | nupapajjahaṁ → nūpapajj ahaṁ (pts)
tha-ap177:4.2: te → āsuno (bj: sī.selu) | te → aṭṭha āsayuṁ (cck: ka.) | te → G. S1 no. (pts note)
tha-ap177:4.3: siluccayasanāmā ca → sīluccayasanāmā va (pts) | va → G. S1 ca. (pts note)
